focus: Answers per part of the Question line (steer iteration 4)
noveltyJustification: First consolidated verdict for the steer's three questions, with per-part falsifiers and the two hook design extensions (delivered-set keying; boundary-epoch-only suppression) named as build-packet deltas.

statement: Part 1 answer: AGENTS.md carries binding clauses plus pointer lines (the §8 pattern), never full rule text; stay inside the 16,384-byte guaranteed delivery budget observed in this runtime. Falsifier: a measured prohibition that moves only when its full text is resident.

Part 2 answer: Gate 5 loads router plus matched rule cards with full text on demand; ~70-80% load-event reduction at measured bounds (6.2-8.2k -> 0.7-1.8k tokens); keeps the action key and the nothing-fires silence; no new surface. Falsifier: measured compliance drop, frequent card-insufficient full opens, or cards unbuildable in rule-anatomy bands.

Part 3 answer: no hook now; future role is action-boundary card delivery on the directive-lifecycle window model, extended with (a) delivered-set keying and (b) boundary-epoch-only suppression for transcript-less runtimes; must not be an always-on constant (022 bar). Falsifier: a measured Gate 5 miss rate with cost; or a probe showing transcript evidence everywhere plus the extension built.
Consistency: the answers reopen neither the advisor-pointer refusal nor the trigger-index refusal; measure-before-build applies to the hook only; concision playbook remains other lineages' scope.
